constructionNotes: Six actual boundary vertices feed short inward stems, each ending in a separate pointed bud. Buds turn toward the centre but stop four reaches away; that central hexagonal negative space is deliberately left open. This reverses the outward flower reading without changing B05's source lattice.
limits: Finite native chords, shared prototypes and actual landmark-offset witnesses; no analytic curvature, occupied-face clearance, automatic physical join from coordinate equality, learned beauty, or hidden over/under continuity is claimed.
